## Summary

- [ ] Pedals / input
- [ ] Story Mode setup / Online safety
- [ ] UI / UX
- [ ] Other

## Hardware (if relevant)
- **MOZA base**: R3 / R5 / R9 / R12 / R16 / other
- **Pedals**: yes / no (model if known)

Screenshots, mockups, links, examples.
